title: Late-Change Fee on Moved Outpatient Surgery Package Bookings (Good Faith & Price Estimates)
content:
When the patient moves a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery booking to a new date at short notice — a late patient move of the booking — a late-change fee falls due under Good Faith & Price Estimates and is kept by Riverbend out of the deposits held on that booking. Keeping the fee is an agent service action.

**Deposit on the booking.** The late-change fee is retained only once an initial deposit collection stands on the surgery booking. Put another way, the fee is kept from a booking whose deposit activity shows an initial deposit collection, and from no other booking.

## Fee tool

**Capability.** Keep the late-change fee on a Riverbend self-pay outpatient surgery package booking that the patient moved to a new date with short notice. One call records one retained-fee entry on the booking, drawn on the named deposit collection: the fee amount is taken out of the deposits held on the booking and kept by Riverbend, and the deposits held fall by that amount. The patient can be told the fee kept and the new deposits-held figure.

**How it is invoked.** `retain_late_change_fee_0cd5c1f6` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `estimate_id` | Id class — the reference number of the patient's outpatient surgery package estimate, as listed by the estimate lookup for this patient. |
| `source_estimate_txn_id` | Id class — the reference number of the deposit collection on that booking the fee is drawn on, as listed in the booking's deposit activity. |
| `amount` | Fixed-format class — the fee kept, in USD, 2 decimal places, positive magnitude (USD, 2 decimal places, positive magnitude); the value is rounded half-up to the cent when recorded, and an empty value is not accepted. |

**Return.** A text receipt `Fee retained: fee_txn_id=..., source_estimate_txn_id=..., amount=..., deposit_held_usd=...`, where `fee_txn_id` is the reference number of the new retained-fee entry, `source_estimate_txn_id` is the deposit collection it draws on, `amount` is the fee kept in USD with 2 decimal places, and `deposit_held_usd` is the deposits still held on the booking in USD with 2 decimal places. The receipt line beginning "Fee retained" confirms the entry was recorded.
